items.title: Abstract LB340: Mechanism-based trial matching reveals a 54% target alignment gap in ovarian cancer: Quantifying the precision-eligible ovarian cancer patients
items.summary: We quantify how often mechanism-aligned precision oncology trials match the molecular profile of ovarian cancer patients. A 54% target alignment gap highlights the need for mechanism-based trial matching rather than histology-only eligibility.

items.title: Intercepting metastasis: 8-step CRISPR design via multi-modal foundation models.
items.summary: An eight-step CRISPR design workflow powered by multi-modal foundation models targets metastatic progression. The pipeline links genomic context, pathway priors, and guide RNA selection for interception of metastatic colonization.

items.title: Abstract B065: Stage-aware CRISPR design for brain metastasis interception: Multi-modal validation of BBB extravasation and CNS colonization targets
items.summary: Stage-aware CRISPR designs prioritize blood–brain barrier extravasation and CNS colonization targets for brain metastasis. Multi-modal models validate target sets across metastatic stages before therapeutic design.
items.bodyText: F Kiani, SA Allah · Cancer Research 86 (6_Supplement), B065-B065, 2026

items.title: Abstract LB-B013: Eight-Pathway transcriptomic biomarker outperforms PD-L1 for anti-PD-1 response prediction in melanoma
items.summary: An eight-pathway transcriptomic signature predicts anti-PD-1 response in melanoma more accurately than PD-L1 alone. The biomarker integrates immune and tumor-intrinsic programs for responder stratification.
items.bodyText: F Kiani, SA Allah · Cancer Immunology Research 14 (2_Supplement), LB-B013-LB-B013, 2026

items.title: Abstract B025: An agentic platform for designing cancer immunotherapies: From automated variant interpretation to in silico therapeutic validation
items.summary: CrisPRO presents an agentic workflow that connects variant interpretation, therapeutic hypothesis generation, and in silico validation for cancer immunotherapy design. The platform automates evidence synthesis across genomic and pathway layers.
items.bodyText: F Kiani, R Nayeem · Cancer Immunology Research 13 (9_Supplement), B025-B025, 2025
